services.name: Featured Exhibits
services.desc: Along with all the exciting exhibits that have been on display over the years, visitors to the Museum can now also enjoy the following features… In celebration of the 50th Anniversary of Title IX, Athletes Unlimited created a limited number of original, commemorative Title IX jerseys which were worn by all its players, including former Little Leaguers, Aliyah Andrews and Rachele Fico, on June 23, 2022. A group of local Little Leaguers also took part in the celebration, throwing nine simultaneous first pitches. Before watching their favorite pros in action. services.desc: The audio for this virtual presentation is a portion of what is available on our museum’s Audio Tour Guides. Since you can access these recordings simply by pressing play on your own device, there’s no need to enter any numbers in order to hear each presentation. Welcome to the first inning of your outdoor tour of the Little League International complex. To start your orientation, please stand near the first-inning interpretive panel, and face downhill.
